constraints.name: trip_source_output_slots_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((support_payload IS NULL) AND (retention_state = 'IDENTITY_ONLY'::text)) OR ((support_payload IS NOT NULL) AND public.trip_import_json_valid(support_payload, 262144))))

constraints.name: trip_source_output_slots_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((receipt_ref IS NULL) = (result_target_kind IS NULL)) AND ((receipt_ref IS NULL) = (result_target_id IS NULL)) AND ((receipt_ref IS NULL) = (result_revision IS NULL)) AND ((receipt_ref IS NULL) = (receipt_sha256 IS NULL))))

constraints.name: trip_source_output_slots_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((receipt_ref IS NULL) OR ((result_target_kind = intended_target_kind) AND (result_target_id = intended_target_id))))

constraints.name: trip_source_output_slots_check5
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state <> ALL (ARRAY['DOMAIN_SUCCEEDED'::text, 'EVIDENCE_PENDING'::text, 'FINALIZED'::text])) AND (finalization_state = 'NONE'::text)) OR ((state = 'DOMAIN_SUCCEEDED'::text) AND (finalization_state = 'PENDING'::text)) OR ((state = 'EVIDENCE_PENDING'::text) AND (finalization_state = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::text, 'BLOCKED'::text]))) OR ((state = 'FINALIZED'::text) AND (finalization_state = 'COMPLETE'::text))))

constraints.name: trip_source_output_slots_check8
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((no_commit_basis IS NULL) AND (no_commit_receipt_ref IS NULL) AND (no_commit_receipt_sha256 IS NULL)) OR ((no_commit_basis = 'UNDISPATCHED_REVOKED'::text) AND (state = 'CANCELED'::text) AND (dispatched_at IS NULL) AND (no_commit_receipt_ref IS NULL) AND (no_commit_receipt_sha256 IS NULL) AND (NOT create_claim_active)) OR ((no_commit_basis = 'VERIFIED_TERMINAL_RECEIPT'::text) AND (state = ANY (ARRAY['FAILED'::text, 'CONFLICTED'::text])) AND (no_commit_receipt_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (no_commit_receipt_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT create_claim_active))))

constraints.name: trip_source_output_slots_check9
constraints.definition:
CHECK ((((disposition = ANY (ARRAY['CREATE'::text, 'UPDATE'::text, 'LINK_ONLY'::text])) AND (intended_target_kind IS NOT NULL) AND (intended_target_id IS NOT NULL) AND (adapter_key IS NOT NULL) AND (adapter_version IS NOT NULL) AND (domain_operation_key IS NOT NULL) AND (domain_intent_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (reviewed_payload IS NOT NULL)) OR ((disposition = ANY (ARRAY['REJECT'::text, 'DEFER'::text])) AND (intended_target_kind IS NULL) AND (intended_target_id IS NULL) AND (base_revision IS NULL) AND (adapter_key IS NULL) AND (adapter_version IS NULL) AND (domain_operation_key IS NULL) AND (domain_intent_sha256 IS NULL) AND (receipt_ref IS NULL) AND (support_payload = '{}'::jsonb) AND (state =
CASE disposition
    WHEN 'REJECT'::text THEN 'REJECTED'::text
    ELSE 'DEFERRED'::text
END))))

constraints.name: trip_source_representations_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK (public.trip_source_uuid_array_valid(parent_ids,
CASE
    WHEN (role = 'ORIGINAL'::text) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
END,
CASE
    WHEN (role = 'ORIGINAL'::text) THEN 0
    ELSE 16
END))

constraints.name: trip_source_representations_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((payload_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (payload_sha256 IS NOT NULL)) OR ((payload_sha256 IS NULL) AND (retention_state = 'IDENTITY_ONLY'::text))))

constraints.name: trip_source_representations_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((byte_count >= 0) AND (byte_count <= '9007199254740991'::bigint)) AND (byte_count IS NOT NULL)) OR ((byte_count IS NULL) AND (retention_state = 'IDENTITY_ONLY'::text))))

constraints.name: trip_source_representations_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((role = 'ORIGINAL'::text) AND (transform_key IS NULL) AND (transform_version IS NULL) AND (transform_options_sha256 IS NULL) AND (regenerability = 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text)) OR ((role = 'DERIVED'::text) AND (transform_key IS NOT NULL) AND (transform_version IS NOT NULL) AND ((transform_options_sha256 IS NOT NULL) OR (retention_state = 'IDENTITY_ONLY'::text)) AND (regenerability = ANY (ARRAY['POSSIBLE'::text, 'IMPOSSIBLE'::text])))))

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((capture_time_basis = 'UNKNOWN'::text) = (captured_at IS NULL)) AND ((captured_at IS NULL) OR isfinite(captured_at))))

constraints.name: trip_sources_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((lifecycle = 'DELETED'::text) = (deleted_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((lifecycle = 'DELETED'::text) = (deleted_by IS NOT NULL)) AND ((deleted_at IS NULL) OR isfinite(deleted_at))))

constraints.name: trip_sources_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (((acquisition_channel = 'COPY'::text) OR ((source_kind = 'FILE'::text) AND (acquisition_channel = 'FILES'::text)) OR ((source_kind = 'IMAGE'::text) AND (acquisition_channel = ANY (ARRAY['CAMERA'::text, 'PHOTOS'::text, 'FILES'::text]))) OR ((source_kind = 'TEXT'::text) AND (acquisition_channel = 'PASTE'::text)) OR ((source_kind = 'URL'::text) AND (acquisition_channel = 'URL_CAPTURE'::text)) OR ((source_kind = 'EMAIL'::text) AND (acquisition_channel = 'EMAIL_INPUT'::text))))

constraints.name: trip_sources_deleted_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (deleted_by) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: trip_sources_trip_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (trip_id) REFERENCES public.trips(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
